title: Grader advisory verdict (grader-verdict)
description: Appended by the change-grader agent after grading the change against the grader-features record and the raw diff. Carries a short change summary, the five facets (each a clear/concern/unknown verdict plus a one-line note), a prose rationale, and the clear/concern verdict — produced in facet-note-then-rationale-then-verdict order. The verdict is ADVISORY: it is surfaced to the session and recorded, but nothing routes on it and no one merges on it — a human does. It is not a merge or correctness gate. The verdict must equal the worst-facet aggregation of the five facets: any facet concern or unknown -> concern; all five clear -> clear. Never average. A verdict that contradicts its own facets is wrong by construction.

responding_to.description: 1-indexed line number(s) in .scratch/handoff.jsonl pointing to the grader-features record this verdict was formed against.

summary.description: A short imperative name for the change, derived from the diff, e.g. 'relabel unknown-activity bucket'. Renders in the report title beside the req_id.

facets.description: The five facets, each judged on its own. Each carries a clear/concern/unknown verdict and a one-line plain-prose note explaining that verdict. unknown counts as a concern.

rationale.description: Prose explaining why the verdict was reached, roughly 20-60 words. The reasoning that produced the verdict, not a justification written after; states the decisive point and what the human should do. Renders under the Verdict heading.

verdict.description: clear, concern, or unknown. Never numeric. unknown means genuinely insufficient information and counts as a concern.

note.description: One plain-prose explanation of this facet's verdict. Renders as the paragraph under the facet's section heading.
